searchText: Which existing testnets are _likely_ (I know nothing is decided yet) to exist after the merge? My gut says Goerli and Sepolia but wondering if there's been any discussions on the topic yet. I think Ropsten is still up in the air: at the very least I think we should transition it to PoS, but possibly we don't maintain it after that. Unsure what the Kovan situation is, but I've heard xDAI might be maintaining it **AllCoreDevs in 23h (Jan 21, 14:00 UTC)** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/449 Stream: https://youtu.be/VffwWtklJvA Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09 whats the latest on EL authenticating calls from CL? What should I be reading if I'm going to implement that. https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/162 perfect, thx! (classic beiko) Just added to ACD agenda for tomorrow! lol we are simpatico ser, I was asking because I saw it was missing. aces! It put on the agenda already, but so it doesn't get missed: - [EIP-2315: Simple Subroutines for the EVM](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2315) is still alive.
